action: If you receive a notice from MPOWERHealth, take up any identity protection offered and review bank, credit and insurance statements for unfamiliar activity.
exec: Notification roughly 17 months after the incident was identified raises regulatory and litigation exposure.
plain: A Texas healthcare company is telling patients that a hack found in mid-2025 exposed personal, financial and medical information.
summary: The Texas musculoskeletal care company began mailing notices on November 13 after confirming on October 20 that protected health information was exposed when an unauthorized party reached part of its network, an incident identified around June 26, 2025. Data may include Social Security and government ID numbers, financial account, medical and insurance information. The number affected is not yet published.
title: MPOWERHealth begins notifying patients of network breach first identified in June 2025

validation.note: One trade outlet citing the company's state breach filing.
